notes:
Account overview: TealBridge builds a product search layer for mid-market ecommerce and catalog SaaS customers. They care about predictable unit economics for embeddings and sub-100ms search latencies at 95th percentile. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast onboarding) then likely moving to Dedicated if nightly batch throughput + cost targets met.

Key technical points / asks:
- Primary workload is nightly batch embedding of incremental content (target ~200k docs/night) and nearline query-time semantic search against ~500k - 1M embedding index.
- Integration preference: they currently use Postgres + pgvector for vectors; want to test Redwood + managed vector DB vs running Redwood-hosted embeddings + pushing to their DB.
- Throughput targets: ingestion pipeline needs ~1.5-2k embeddings/sec sustained for batch window; query latency SLO 50-150ms for top-k under normal traffic.
- Cost sensitivity: Finance asked for 6-12 month TCO comparison hosted vs dedicated (including network egress, storage, and per-token embed price).
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, support for KMS + audit logs. A subset of customers require EU data residency; would like region routing/fallback.
- Product asks: fallback routing to smaller/cheaper embedding models during spikes, transparent per-route cost breakdown in Console, recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce cost.

Quotes and call snippets: "Need predictable per-embedding cost at scale — finance won't accept wide variance" (Head of Ops). "Search has to feel instant for enterprise buyers — 95th pct under 150ms" (PM).

Stubs/links: security deck + pricing deck shared in Drive. Fireflies transcript for 2026-02-15 workshop attached. Jira created for Dedicated sizing request.

Recommendation for Redwood: prioritize canned pgvector integration doc, propose 2-week hosted API throughput test with predefined metrics (embeddings/sec, cost/1k, 95th pct latency for queries), and an initial Dedicated sizing + pricing draft to move procurement forward.
